note: Application code is authoritative. A variable declared only in a template is UNUSED.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.productionRequiredReason: Prisma datasource url = env("DATABASE_URL") in prisma/schema.prisma. The canonical and only database connection source.

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.productionRequiredReason: AES-256-GCM key for stored integration tokens. src/lib/social/token-encryption.ts THROWS in production unless it is 64 hex characters.

variables.name: FILE_SIGN_SECRET
variables.productionRequiredReason: Signs secure download URLs. src/app/api/employee-access/secure-download/route.ts throws in production when shorter than 32 characters.

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
variables.productionRequiredReason: next-auth v4 session token signing. src/app/api/portal-auth/login/route.ts returns WITHOUT setting the session cookie when absent, so login silently yields no session.

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_URL
variables.productionRequiredReason: next-auth v4 absolute callback/redirect base. Must equal the public origin in production.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.productionRequiredReason: Public origin baked into the client bundle at build time; wrong value breaks absolute links and CORS-sensitive calls.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.productionRequiredReason: Must be "production" so fail-closed security branches (encryption key, demo login, secure download) are active.
